title: Chapter 891
text:
The spacetime lock area was the same, and the Mechanics could not open the secondary dimension channel. EsGod's Dimension Crevice and teleportation also lost their effects.

The three Universal Civilizations had recorded countless Esper Abilities, and most of them had methods to counter them. Other than some Super High Risk Esper Abilities, there were no abilities that could not be countered.

"So, it was a trap. How generous."

EsGod was surprised for a moment before regaining his composure.

This was not the first time he had experienced such danger, so he did not panic. Only the number of enemies surprised him. Not only the dynasty and Ethereal, even the Radiant Federation also participated in the encirclement.

A total of eleven Beyond Grade As besieging him, this was beyond his expectations.

If not for the fact that the three Universal Civilizations had sent enough manpower this time, it would have been very difficult for him to fall into this trap. It was obvious that at least four to five people would be needed to deal with EsGod head-on without him suspecting anything, and three Mages would also be needed to set up a spacetime lock area without being discovered. In other words, at least seven to eight people were needed. Luo Zhong said with a deep voice, "Manison, I didn't think that you would come to deal with me too."

Among the eleven people, EsGod only had eyes for four, which were Manison, Milizaus, Sun Hunter, and Han Xiao. He had fought with all of them before, and Manison was his most important opponent.

"It's just a deal. Furthermore, I warned you not to step into the Primeval Star River," Manison said calmly.

EsGod nodded and looked at everyone.

Although he was surrounded, he did not panic and slowly said, "Even if you have more people, it won't be that easy to get rid of me."

He had two escape plans. One was to escape the trap area, but now that he was surrounded, it was basically a failure. He could only choose the second plan, which was to use his Space Esper Ability to slowly penetrate the spacetime lock area, drill a crevice, and teleport away.

The prerequisite for this plan was to stall for enough time.

EsGod's confidence came from his large number of doppelgangers. Even if he was surrounded, he could use his doppelgangers to deal with everyone. He also had all kinds of self-healing, energy absorption, and defensive Esper Abilities to ensure that he would not be defeated in a short time. Thus, EsGod was not nervous at all.

Everyone had analyzed the situation before the battle and knew that they could not stall for time. They looked at each other and nodded.

"Follow the plan."

"I'm counting on you, Black Star."

In the next moment, everyone attacked at the same time, and a joint attack erupted!

EsGod's dozens of doppelgangers were engaged in a fierce battle with the Beyond Grade As, and the rate of casualties was extremely fast. However, EsGod continued to absorb energy through his Esper Ability, creating new doppelgangers and withstanding the attacks of eleven Beyond Grade As! Although EsGod barely fought, it was already shocking enough.

Even the surrounding Beyond Grade As could not help but marvel at this level of combat strength.

The evolved EsGod was truly a monster!

If not for Black Star's suggestion to join forces to deal with him, who else would be able to threaten him in the future?

Han Xiao shuttled through the battlefield, passing through the heavy blockade of doppelgangers under the cover of the others, and approached EsGod's main body.

EsGod had already fought with Han Xiao earlier, so he did not suspect anything and continued fighting with Han Xiao.

However, as soon as their bodies touched, EsGod felt a strange energy coming from Han Xiao's body and entering his body.

The next moment, the restless Esper Abilities in EsGod's body seemed to have been injected with a tranquilizer, and they all quieted down.

"This is … Esper Silence?"

EsGod's expression suddenly changed, and he finally revealed a shocked expression. His eyes were filled with doubt, not understanding why Han Xiao had his ability.

"It's effective!" Han Xiao received the notification on the interface and heaved a sigh of relief.

During the pre-battle meeting, he had already discussed the strategy with the others. He would only use the Esper Silence Character Summon Card when they were surrounded.

Han Xiao had been hiding this move all along, waiting for this opportunity.

The moment Esper Silence took effect, the movements of all the doppelgangers froze, and he could not maintain this ability. All the doppelgangers exploded, turning into black mist and dissipating.

Because the difference was too great, the duration of Esper Silence was the minimum. However, this instant disrupted EsGod's doppelganger strategy!

Everyone was already prepared. The moment EsGod lost his Esper Ability, the three Mages cast the control spells they had prepared, the Psychics interfered with EsGod's mental operation, the Pugilists used energy to suppress EsGod's main body, and Han Xiao injected EsGod's main body with a nano-sized cell suppressor to reduce his energy activity.

In an instant, EsGod was under heavy control. Many Beyond Grade As suppressed his movements at the same time, making him almost unable to move.

His strength recovered very quickly, and he tried to break free. However, the control spells of so many Beyond Grade As were like indestructible shackles, binding every single one of his limbs and fixing him on the spot.

Under the multiple effects, the energy in his body stagnated and could not be used. He could not turn it into fuel to activate his Esper Ability.

Although the doppelganger strategy was very strong, in terms of pure energy, he could not withstand the combined attacks of so many Beyond Grade As.

EsGod stared at Han Xiao, confused.

"How do you know how to use my ability?"

"You have plenty of time to think about it in the future."

Han Xiao did not hesitate. He took out the Spacetime Amber and used it on EsGod. After entering the second layer of the Soul Connection, the production speed of the amber balls increased.

The Spacetime Amber was the core of this plan!

So many people could suppress EsGod, but they could not stay together forever. EsGod had all kinds of Esper Abilities, and other methods of imprisonment were useless against him. He had countless ways to escape.

Only the Spacetime Amber, which had proven its effects, could possibly imprison EsGod.

It was decided in the pre-battle meeting that Han Xiao would be the core of this operation, and everyone's job was to help him capture EsGod with the Spacetime Amber.

If not for the Esper Silence and the Spacetime Amber, EsGod might have really escaped. These two things were the key variables in this operation.

EsGod also had a very strong perception of space. Sensing that the space around him was distorting, a look of realization appeared in his eyes.

"So, this is the legendary effect of the Spacetime Amber. What a magical Universal Treasure."

EsGod paused for a moment and barely moved his facial muscles. "I never thought that I would fall into your hands."

Han Xiao knew that if a villain spoke too much, the tables would be turned. He did not plan to speak and focused on activating the Spacetime Amber at full power.

Seeing that the situation was hopeless, EsGod stopped struggling and stared at Han Xiao with an expressionless face. His tone was profound.

"Black Star, we will meet again sooner or later."

"That will depend on when the three Universal Civilizations ask me to let you out."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he suddenly cut off the energy supply.

The next moment, EsGod's expression and actions were completely frozen.

He was completely sealed in the Spacetime Amber!

— —

(A new month has begun. Looking for a monthly ticket.)
